name: Overlay
description: Shows a data source's image in a zone of the screen, over the background, until the next run replaces it or the data source has nothing to show.

properties.name: dataSource
properties.title: Data Source
properties.description: What to show: a data source made for overlays.

properties.name: zone
properties.title: Zone
properties.description: Where on the screen: one of six boxes, three across the top and three across the bottom.

properties.name: outline
properties.title: Outline
properties.description: An outline around the text so it reads over a busy picture, in the theme's outline color (white, or black on a black page): 0 is none, 1 is the full width (a fraction of the text size, not pixels).

properties.name: cueOutput
properties.title: Output
properties.description: An output that plays a cue when this task runs, so a reminder is heard or felt as its page goes to the panel: one of the GPIO settings' Outputs. Empty: none. The quiet hours keep it still.

properties.name: cue
properties.title: Cue
properties.description: What the output plays, once: a bell, a count (One, Two, Three) or a rhythm (Steady, Slow, Fast, Heartbeat).
